lifecycle_table.areatrigger: re-entry (or a second AT) refreshes the unit's own aura
lifecycle_table.dynobj: no refresh path: each cast creates a new DynamicObject + aura (same-caster overlap blocked per unit)
lifecycle_table.question: parent refresh
lifecycle_table.unit-area: re-hit of the owner refreshes the one parent: every recipient sees the new duration and (non-pandemic) the reset tick schedule; ChangeAmount(REAPPLY) runs on every application

lifecycle_table.areatrigger: AT expiry: HandleUnitEnterExit({}, ByExpire) runs UndoActions on every inside unit (unless DontRunOnLeaveWhenExpiring suppresses only the hooks, not UndoActions)
lifecycle_table.dynobj: DynamicObject::Update -> remove list -> _Remove(AURA_REMOVE_BY_DEFAULT): recipients never see BY_EXPIRE
lifecycle_table.question: parent expiry
lifecycle_table.unit-area: Unit::_UpdateSpells removes the expired parent after all owner updates: every recipient BY_EXPIRE; the tick at duration 0 is delivered first

lifecycle_table.areatrigger: no death path in AreaTrigger.cpp (caster despawn: RemoveAllAreaTriggers on leave-world)
lifecycle_table.dynobj: caster death has no removal path (dynobjs are removed on leave-world only)
lifecycle_table.question: owner death
lifecycle_table.unit-area: non-passive and non-death-persistent: parent removed BY_DEATH from every recipient at the death; passive or death-persistent: parent survives, the dead owner leaves its own map at the next update (CheckTarget TARGETS_DEAD) while others keep it; ATTR7_DISABLE_AURA_WHILE_DEAD empties the map at the next update

lifecycle_table.areatrigger: templated ATs drop dead/ghost players unless action-set flags allow (AreaTrigger.cpp:687-701); the per-unit aura follows the normal death path
lifecycle_table.question: recipient death / resurrection
lifecycle_table.unit-area: the recipient's own application unapplied BY_DEATH (unless passive / death-persistent); the parent continues; after resurrection a new application of the same parent at the next map update (remaining duration)

lifecycle_table.areatrigger: per-unit aura is owned by the recipient: normal cancel / dispel; the AT does not re-add it until re-entry
lifecycle_table.dynobj: never cancellable / dispellable by a recipient (no unit owns it)
lifecycle_table.question: cancel / dispel on a recipient
lifecycle_table.unit-area: ignored for non-owners (cancel: RemoveOwnedAura on the player; dispel list: owned auras only); on the owner the whole parent goes (CANCEL / ENEMY_SPELL)

lifecycle_table.question: owner leaves the world
lifecycle_table.unit-area: applications on other units removed (default mode); the owner's own application and the parent persist (the owner stops updating)

lifecycle_table.areatrigger: same caster: one aura, refreshed; any AT exit removes it (even if still inside the other AT)
lifecycle_table.dynobj: same caster + same spell never stack on a unit (CanStackWith dynobj rule)
lifecycle_table.question: two sources cover one unit
lifecycle_table.unit-area: a non-stacking second parent is refused while the first application exists (UpdateTargetMap stack filter; owner exempt); take-over at the take-over parent's next map update after the holder unmaps -> latency depends on owner update order

rules.definition: Every recipient of a unit/dynobj area aura holds an application of one parent Aura; its remaining duration, stacks, charges and amount are the parent's (a late or re-entering recipient gets the remaining duration).
rules.name: one-parent-duration

rules.definition: The recipient map is recomputed when m_updateTargetMapInterval <= diff, then reset to 500; a spell-hit UnitAura first maps at its first owner update, AddAura / dynobj auras map at creation.
rules.name: 500ms-recipient-map

counterexamples: script OnEffectUpdatePeriodic / OnEffectPeriodic hooks may prevent a tick per application
rules.definition: A periodic area effect ticks on one timer per AuraEffect; each tick reaches exactly the applications holding the effect during that owner update (map updated before effects).
rules.name: shared-tick-to-current-holders

rules.definition: Removing the parent (expire, owner death, cancel/dispel on the owner) unapplies every recipient with one remove mode; dynobj expiry uses AURA_REMOVE_BY_DEFAULT.
rules.name: parent-removal-propagates

rules.definition: Cancel and dispel aimed at a non-owner recipient do nothing; recipient death / leave-world unapplies only that application and the parent continues.
rules.name: recipient-side-requests-stop-at-application

population.name: unit-area + dynobj recipients that are not the owner

rules.definition: Owner death removes a non-passive, non-death-persistent area aura BY_DEATH; passive or death-persistent parents survive and keep serving living recipients (ATTR7 empties the map at the next update).
rules.name: owner-death-policy

rules.definition: AreaTrigger ADDAURA / enter-cast auras are separate Aura objects owned by each unit, with their own duration and timers; exit removes every aura of that spell from that caster on the unit.
rules.name: areatrigger-per-unit-aura

population.name: current-player AT rows whose actions/scripts give each unit its own aura (targeting areatriggers corpus)

trinity_defects.description: UndoActions removes every aura of the action spell from the AT caster on the exiting unit (RemoveAurasDueToSpell(spell, casterGuid)), including one refreshed by another overlapping AT of the same caster the unit is still inside.
trinity_defects.lifecycle_effect: unit loses the aura although still inside an AT that grants it; not re-added until re-entry
trinity_defects.oracle_behaviour: reproduced in at_timeline (S18 p3 at 1500); no current-player AT known to overlap itself

trinity_defects.description: Cooldown-on-event handling runs per application: every new recipient restarts the infinite cooldown and every recipient that leaves sends the cooldown event, while the parent aura is still active.
trinity_defects.lifecycle_effect: caster cooldown can start when any recipient leaves an area aura with SPELL_ATTR0_COOLDOWN_ON_EVENT (or a CooldownEventOnLeaveCombat category)
trinity_defects.oracle_behaviour: flagged by census flag cooldown_on_event; not simulated

trinity_defects.description: Persistent-area-aura expiry reaches recipients as AURA_REMOVE_BY_DEFAULT (via the remove list) instead of BY_EXPIRE.
trinity_defects.lifecycle_effect: remove-mode-gated script hooks (GetRemoveMode() == EXPIRE) never run for dynobj recipients
